# Cookbook

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-references.mjs from lib/table.mjs. Do not edit. -->

The patterns that come up on every page, written the way this format wants them.

## Page shell

```html
<section data-id="home" data-type="page" data-name="Home" data-canvas="0,0" style="width:390px;height:844px">
  <div data-id="home__root" data-type="frame" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--color-bg)">
  </div>
</section>
```

The page owns its own size. The root fills it.

## A vertical stack with spacing

```html
<div data-id="home__list" data-type="frame" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:24px">
</div>
```

`gap` is the whole spacing system. There is no `margin`.

## A row that pushes its ends apart

```html
<div data-id="home__bar" data-type="frame" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:48px;padding:0 16px;background-color:#ffffff">
</div>
```

## Two children that split the width

```html
<div data-id="home__split" data-type="frame" style="display:flex;flex-direction:row;gap:8px">
  <div data-id="home__left" data-type="frame" style="flex:1 1 0%;min-width:0"></div>
  <div data-id="home__right" data-type="frame" style="flex:1 1 0%;min-width:0"></div>
</div>
```

`flex:1 1 0%` plus `min-width:0` is the one spelled way to fill a row. Without
`min-width:0`, a long word pushes the child past its share.

## A card

```html
<div data-id="home__card" data-type="frame" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:16px;background-color:#ffffff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #00000014">
</div>
```

## Text sizes

| Role | Style |
|---|---|
| Display | `font-size:44px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1` |
| Title | `font-size:24px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25` |
| Body | `font-size:16px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5` |
| Label | `font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4` |
| Caption | `font-size:12px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.4;color:#6b7280` |

## A pill

```html
<p data-id="home__tag" data-type="text" style="font-size:12px;font-weight:500;padding:4px 10px;background-color:#f3f4f6;border-radius:9999px;color:#374151">New</p>
```

`border-radius:9999px` is the pill. A circle is `border-radius:50%` on a square box.

## An image that fills its box

```html
<img data-id="home__photo" data-type="image" src="photo.jpg" alt="A room" style="width:100%;height:200px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px">
```

`alt` is required. `alt=""` marks a decorative image, and that is different from
omitting it.

## A photo when the user gave none

Take the `src` from `references/images.md`, and write its `alt` and credit with it:

```html
<img data-id="home__photo" data-type="image" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1543988884-c01cfa7b41c2?w=1080&amp;q=80&amp;fm=jpg" alt="Turquoise water meeting a white sand beach" data-credit="Photo by Harry Holder on Unsplash" style="width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px">
```

`data-credit` names the photographer. It never renders, and the Licence does not
require it: keeping it costs one attribute and makes the source of a photo findable
later.

## A background image

```html
<div data-id="home__hero" data-type="frame" style="height:240px;background-image:url(&quot;hero.jpg&quot;);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div>
```

## A gradient scrim

```html
<div data-id="home__scrim" data-type="frame" style="height:120px;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff00,#00000099)"></div>
```

Only linear gradients. A radial or a mesh gradient is refused, with the reason named.

## The most common refusals

| Written | Refused because | Write this |
|---|---|---|
| `animation` | No animation. A design file is a still. | remove it |
| `border-bottom` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 0 0 1px 0` |
| `border-left` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 0 0 0 1px` |
| `border-right` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 0 1px 0 0` |
| `border-top` | Use border-width with four values for one edge. | `border-width: 1px 0 0 0` |
| `cursor` | The format describes appearance, not interaction. A cursor is behavior. | remove it |
| `font` | Write the longhand properties. | `font-family, font-size, font-weight and line-height` |
| `grid-gap` | The property is named gap. | `gap` |
| `grid-template-columns` | The format has no grid. Flex covers the same layouts. | `display:flex with flex:1 on the children` |
| `grid-template-rows` | The format has no grid. Flex covers the same layouts. | `display:flex with flex:1 on the children` |
| `margin-bottom` | Write the shorthand: margin: 0 0 8px 0. | `gap on the parent, or margin on this element` |
| `margin-left` | Write the shorthand: margin: 0 0 0 8px. | `gap on the parent, or margin on this element` |
